title: 반려동물 이야기: 강아지, 고양이를 키워요
objective: By the end, you can use ten words about pets in short sentences, such as saying what animal you keep, how you take care of it, and what it does.
summary: This worksheet covers ten everyday words for talking about pets in Korean, including keeping, feeding, and walking an animal.

task.title: Use the pet words
task.line: Use the ten words from page 1. Change the verb or adjective endings where the sentence needs it.

words.exampleMeaning: I have loved animals since I was little.

words.meaning: puppy; often used for any pet dog
words.exampleMeaning: My friend brought home a new puppy.

words.example: 고양이가 창문 앞에서 하루 종일 자요.
words.exampleMeaning: The cat sleeps in front of the window all day.
I have two cats at home.

words.meaning: food for animals, feed (people usually say 밥 for their own pet)
words.example: 물고기한테 먹이를 하루에 한 번 줘요.
words.exampleMeaning: I feed the fish once a day.

words.meaning: to go for a walk (here, walking a dog)
words.exampleMeaning: I walk my dog in the park every evening.
My clothes are covered in cat hair.
When a dog is happy, it wags its tail.
My dog barked at night, so I felt sorry for my neighbors.
The cat in the photo is really cute.

exercises: Choose the right word: 우리 집 개는 모르는 사람이 오면 크게 (짖어요 / 키워요).
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 이 동물원에서는 동물에게 ____를 주면 안 돼요.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 키우다 (polite present, -어요): 저는 집에서 강아지를 ____.
Fill in each blank with 털 or 꼬리: ① 소파에 하얀 ____이 너무 많아요. ② 강아지가 기분이 좋아서 ____를 흔들어요.
Your friend shows you a photo of a baby cat. Complete what you say with the right form of 귀엽다: 와, 이 아기 고양이 정말 ____!
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 강아지하고 / 산책해요 / 저는 / 매일 아침
answers: 저는 매일 아침 강아지하고 산책해요. (also: 매일 아침 저는 강아지하고 산책해요. / 저는 강아지하고 매일 아침 산책해요.)
